all-commands.run.summary: Run any registry command: flag form from the registry, preview, confirm, apply

all-commands.tool.summary: Call a self-management tool that has no command through mcp call: JSON arguments on stdin, dry run first (no parameter form yet)

catalog.commands.summary: The registry listing (toolportctl commands): every command with its tier, search, group filter, and a form per command

catalog.mcp-call.summary: Run a tool: any self-management tool through mcp call with its arguments as JSON on stdin, dry run first, typed confirmation for the destructive tier

servers.gateway.summary: Gateway strip: daemon, tool cache and the profile and discovery each client uses (status)

servers.health.summary: Health tab: status facts and doctor checks with one-click named fixes

servers.list.summary: Servers grouped by attention with live state, tool count and per-profile switches (server ls)

servers.detail.summary: One server: definition, env keys without values, profiles and its login (server info)

servers.inspect.summary: List the live tools of one server, with the failure reason when it cannot connect (inspect)

servers.search.summary: Search the catalog, online or offline (server search)

servers.install.summary: Install a catalog server after a preview (server install)

servers.new.summary: Add a custom server from a command or a URL (server new)

servers.edit.summary: Edit a server's name, command, arguments, URL or working folder (server edit)

servers.remove.summary: Remove a server and its client entries behind a typed confirmation (server uninstall)

servers.profiles.summary: Profiles with their servers and the clients that use them (profile ls)

servers.profile-create.summary: Create a profile, empty or with servers (profile create)

servers.profile-edit.summary: Rename a profile or change its servers with a client-impact preview (profile edit); its switch is also servers_remove_profile_tag (both end in apply_server_enabled)

servers.profile-delete.summary: Delete a profile and clean the client entries scoped to it (profile rm)

servers.profile-inspect.summary: Inspect every server of a profile, with partial results when one needs a login (profile inspect)

servers.clients.summary: Clients with gateway state, profile and what each one sees (client ls)

servers.client-profile.summary: Point a client at a profile after a preview (client edit)

servers.client-sync.summary: Sync the managed clients after a preview (client sync)

servers.client-import.summary: Import the direct entries of a client into the registry (client import)

servers.direct-ls.summary: Direct launcher entries of a client and their state (client direct ls)

servers.direct-add.summary: Give a client one server as its own direct entry (client direct add)

servers.direct-rm.summary: Remove a direct entry Toolport wrote (client direct rm)

servers.direct-run.summary: Start a server over stdio for a direct client entry: copy the command, terminal only

logins.signin.summary: Sign in to an OAuth server in the browser, with the address and a Copy button when the browser cannot open

logins.probe.summary: Probe every login or one server, with or without the cache

logins.secret-set.summary: Set or replace a secret through a write-only field; the value goes to stdin only

logins.secret-reveal.summary: Reveal a secret after a confirmation that follows the policy tier; it hides after 10 seconds

logins.secret-remove.summary: Remove a secret after a confirmation, typed when the policy tier is destructive

logins.statusline.summary: Show the live statusline output and the Claude Code statusline snippet

logins.hook.summary: Show the live session start hook output and the Claude Code hook snippet

skills.list.summary: List every skill and rule with its source badge, source filter, activation, visibility and the sync state per client

skills.status.summary: Show whether the synced outputs still exist: in sync, missing, changed since sync, and what Claude Code rejects

skills.diff.summary: Show the skills new, modified or removed since the last sync; exit 1 with changes still shows its data

skills.lint.summary: Lint all skills and one skill by name; warnings and notes listed per skill

skills.audit.summary: Scan the library for prompt injection and risky commands; findings listed by severity

skills.sync.summary: Pick the clients (those of the lock, never all), preview with the dropped fields, confirm, apply; user level or one project

skills.clean.summary: Remove the synced outputs and the lockfile after a preview and a typed confirmation; user level or one project

skills.uninstall.summary: Uninstall a library skill with its outputs after a preview and typing its name; user level or one project

skills.resolve.summary: Resolve the files that shadow a synced skill with --migrate after a preview of what moves

skills.add.summary: Create a skill or rule from the template, optionally with progressive files: name check, preview, confirm

skills.init.summary: Create the skills repository from the empty state: folder, name, preview of what is created, confirm

skills.bundle.summary: Pack skills into a zip: skills, zip path (native picker), exact command, preview, confirm

skills.unbundle.summary: Extract a skills zip into a folder; every file it overwrites is listed in the plan

skills.tap.ls.summary: List the registered taps with their clone state

skills.tap.add.summary: Add a tap by user/repo or URL (a URL with a credential is refused): preview of the clone, confirm

skills.tap.update.summary: Pull one tap or all taps after a preview; a tap that fails is named in the plan

skills.tap.remove.summary: Remove a tap and its clone after a preview and a plain confirmation (tier write)

skills.search.summary: Search the taps for skills by name, description or tags; an empty answer says so

skills.install.summary: Install from a tap: the preview shows the audit findings, a high finding blocks it, and only a typed --no-audit goes past

sources.ls.summary: Library > Sources: every place Toolport looks with kind, owner, folder, cost labelled estimate, how it is found, read-only marking, status and freshness; items on demand (--items); Rescan (--refresh); partial, empty, error and offline states; the library row with its remote status, Pull and Push (see sources.library.*)

sources.root.ls.summary: The folders the repo, client and vendored detectors scan, with default or added by you, missing and git checkout marks

sources.root.add.summary: Add folder to scan: folder field and native picker, preview of the context.json change, confirm, apply, undo command shown

sources.root.rm.summary: Stop scanning a folder you added: preview, typed confirmation of its name, apply; default folders cannot be removed and say why

sources.library.status.summary: Sources > library row: remote, branch, ahead and behind, files changed here, last fetch, sign-in and duplicate clones from library status; the fetching variant only on Check the remote

sources.library.pull.summary: Pull the library clone: the dry run fetches and lists the commits, Already up to date and a dirty clone offer nothing to confirm, apply shows the files it changed and the undo

sources.library.push.summary: Push the library: the dry run lists commits, audit and secret scan; a secret finding blocks it with the rule, file and line and no apply button, an audit finding only warns, never forced; the same push as the self-MCP tool skills_git_push, whose result fields (pushed, commitSha, checks, repo) are the ones this dialog reads

agents.list.summary: List the agents of the skills repository with model, tools and file, and a row per client with the fields that client drops

agents.lint.summary: Lint the agents; an exit-1 report still shows its messages

agents.audit.summary: Scan the agents for prompt injection and risky commands; findings listed by severity

agents.diff.summary: Show new, modified and removed agents since the last sync

agents.status.summary: Show whether synced agent outputs still exist: in sync, missing or not written, and the drift verdict

agents.add.summary: Create an agent from the template: name check, preview, confirm

agents.sync.summary: Sync agents to every client or one client: preview with the dropped-field warnings, confirm, apply

agents.clean.summary: Remove synced agent outputs after a preview and a typed confirmation, keeping the lockfile

agents.uninstall.summary: Uninstall an agent with its outputs after a preview and typing its name

styles.list.summary: List output styles with where each is synced and always on; empty state with one action; the Always-on in line reads the active style of every client from `styles ls`, the same lockfile entries that the tool styles_active reports

styles.diff.summary: Show new, modified and removed styles since the last sync

styles.status.summary: Show the styles per client: switchable styles of native clients and the always-on style of the others

styles.add.summary: Create a style from the template: name check, preview, confirm

styles.sync.summary: Write every style to the native-toggle clients after a preview and a confirmation

styles.apply.summary: Apply one style as an always-on rule to the other clients after a preview and a confirmation

styles.remove.summary: Remove the active style from the other clients after a preview and a typed confirmation

styles.clean.summary: Remove every synced and applied style file after a preview and a typed confirmation

compression.status.summary: Status strip: provider, runtime, preset, scope, engine health and pin with drift (compression status)

compression.presets.summary: Presets list with the active one, and a refresh of the knob snapshot after a dry run (compression presets)

compression.enable.summary: Enable a provider from a form (preset, mode, port, telemetry) after a preview (compression enable)

compression.disable.summary: Disable compression behind a typed confirmation, optionally tearing the engine down (compression disable)

compression.set-provider.summary: Provider cards with a switch that previews the changes first (compression set-provider)

compression.use.summary: Switch the active preset after a preview (compression use)

compression.sync.summary: Re-apply the policy after a preview (compression sync)

compression.pin.summary: Engine pin card: pinned, installed and drift, Install, Refresh knobs and Set pin (compression pin)

compression.seal.summary: Declare the live proxy posture as policy after a preview (compression seal)

compression.env.summary: Proxy env of a folder: lines, port and launch, with a copy button (compression env)

compression.doctor.summary: Health checks card and Run doctor, a failing check shown with its detail (compression doctor)

compression.run.summary: Launch plan of a folder, and the exact terminal command with a disabled Open in Terminal (compression run)

compression.verify.summary: Verify dialog: local transcripts, buckets, verdict and checks, no model requests (compression verify)

compression.ledger.summary: Savings ledger: chart and table per provider, empty state, Record savings (compression ledger)

compression.proxy.summary: Proxy Start, Stop and Restart behind a confirmation, with the log and a hint on failure (compression proxy)

compression.update.summary: Move the engine pin to a version or the latest build in two steps, preview then accept (compression update)

context.status.summary: Read the layers, launch profiles, legacy duplicates and the shims file with the source-order check; the old shell lines move with a previewed sync

context.plan.summary: Read what a context deploy would write, with the rules and shell-rewrite options and the diff of the shell file

context.apply.summary: Apply the deploy: preview of every file (dry run) equal to the plan, Escape cancels, confirm writes; no-persist keeps the config

context.sync.summary: Plan and apply in one step: the same files as the plan, confirm, result; rewrite-zshrc moves the old shell lines

context.init.summary: Set up the personal layer: preview of the layer and the config, confirm, the layer shows with its scope

context.client-add.summary: Add a client layer for a folder pattern: name and glob, preview, confirm, listed with its glob

context.client-list.summary: List the personal and client layers with their folder patterns and files

context.profile-add.summary: Add a launch profile: name, org file, rules and servers, preview, confirm, listed and its shell function shows

context.profile-list.summary: List the launch profiles with their shell function, org file, rules, servers and whether they are generated

context.profile-remove.summary: Remove a launch profile, optionally its folder: preview and a typed confirmation of the name

context.disable.summary: Remove the generated shims, optionally the profile folders: preview and a typed confirmation

context.loads.summary: Show what a session loads with the token cost per layer, per launch profile and per folder; read again after a write

context.folders.summary: Show the profile per folder and turn routing on or off: no preview, so a confirmation with the exact command line

context.measure.summary: Measure what Claude really loads in a folder: a confirm first, because it spends requests, then the real number labelled measured

context.compose.summary: Read the composed instruction text of a folder, in load order, part by part

context.use.summary: Apply a profile (server set and context bundle) to a folder: plan, confirm, result, undo

context.bundle.ls.summary: List the profiles with where each is applied

context.bundle.show.summary: Show what a profile hides, pairs and where it is applied

context.bundle.add.summary: Create a profile from a folder or from the lists, or duplicate one, after a plan

context.bundle.edit.summary: Change the lists of a profile after a plan, sending only what changed

context.bundle.rm.summary: Delete a profile after a plan and the typed name, with force when it is applied

context.bundle.apply.summary: Apply a profile without a paired server set to a folder: plan, confirm, result

context.bundle.undo.summary: Undo an applied profile in a folder: plan, confirm, result

context.bundle.status.summary: Read the profile applied in a folder and whether it drifted

context.bundle.launch.summary: Prepare the launch line of a profile to copy; Open in Terminal stays off

context.bundle.config.summary: Read and switch the Apply automatically setting, default off

context.client-edit.summary: Change a layer's scope, folders, imports or delivery after a plan

context.client-rm.summary: Delete a client layer after a plan and the typed name

context.checkpoint-status.summary: Gauge of the context used against the checkpoint from the statusline JSON; the JSON goes to stdin through the bridge and is never in an argument or on screen

usage.refresh.summary: Usage tab: tokens per day, per project, server, model and session from the stored index, and Refresh to re-index (usage, --root, --no-refresh)

usage.otel-status.summary: OTel card: receiver state, stored events, the five Claude settings keys and the requests the transcripts lack (obs otel status)

usage.otel-enable.summary: Enable the OTel receiver on a port after a preview of the settings keys it writes (obs otel enable)

usage.otel-disable.summary: Disable the OTel receiver and remove the keys Toolport wrote after a preview (obs otel disable)

system.sync-status.summary: Sync card: machine, backend, repository, last sync and key file; Not set up with a Set up sync action; what a bundle holds and never holds

system.sync-diff.summary: Differences from the remote: new, changed, removed and conflicting files, or In sync

system.sync-init.summary: Set up or reconfigure sync: plan, passphrase twice on stdin, never in argv or DOM

system.sync-push.summary: Push to the bundle: dry-run plan, typed confirmation, apply, last sync changes

system.sync-pull.summary: Pull from the bundle: dry-run plan with conflicts, apply, local files change

system.sync-reset.summary: Reset the local sync setup: plan, typed confirmation, back to Not set up

system.sync-rotate.summary: Rotate the bundle passphrase: new passphrase twice on stdin, typed confirmation

system.sync-project-add.summary: Add a project folder and its files to the sync set

system.sync-project-remove.summary: Remove a project from the sync set

system.sync-git.summary: Git sync of the data folder: status, set up, remove the setup

system.sync-migrate.summary: Import an mcpm sync bundle: folder and its passphrase on stdin

system.update-check.summary: Server updates: check all or one server, per-row state, version and post_update command; apply with a dry-run plan, allow-commands and allow-unverified opt-ins; detect sources (--init)

system.council-install.summary: Install the council: plan, then the API key into the vault on stdin

system.council-uninstall.summary: Uninstall the council with a typed confirmation, optionally deleting the stored key

system.council-doctor.summary: Council doctor checks; a failing check is shown, not hidden

system.import-mcpm.summary: mcpm importer: the preview is the dry-run plan, apply, rejects shown, name map

system.import-rename-refs.summary: Rewrite old tool references: dry-run plan, orphan report with wildcard cases, apply

system.mcp-install.summary: Install the self-management server, optionally into a profile

system.mcp-uninstall.summary: Turn the self-management server off with a typed confirmation

system.mcp-tools.summary: Tool catalogue with tiers and gates, resources, connect-a-client snippet

system.where-am-i.summary: Where am I: data folder, registry, gateway binary, secret store, profile and server counts and login states, read through mcp call where_am_i

system.flow-diagram.summary: How the pieces connect: the flow_diagram markdown drawn as boxes and arrows, read through mcp call

tasks.list.summary: Task list with trigger chips, last run, next run and the waiting-for-you state; invalid task files named

tasks.detail.summary: Task detail: the steps with the needs-you ones marked, the secrets it may write by name, what it needs, triggers and the recent runs with their redacted logs

tasks.history.summary: History tab: every run with result and trigger, and the redacted step log of one run

tasks.run.summary: Run: dry-run plan (steps, secrets it may write, servers needed, whether it waits), confirm, then the run with live steps, a wait at a needs-you step, a result or a failure with the redacted log; also the Refresh task action in Logins

tasks.continue.summary: Continue on a step that waits for you (task resume), then the run goes on to its end

tasks.cancel.summary: Cancel a running or waiting run (task cancel)

tasks.add.summary: New task, Duplicate and Create from a command: form or command file, dry-run plan, confirm, add

tasks.edit.summary: Edit a task through the same form: the whole definition, dry-run diff, confirm, save

tasks.delete.summary: Delete a task with the dry-run plan and the typed id

skills.edit-body.summary: Open editor on a library skill: reads the file with skills_get, shows the body in an editor dialog, previews the change, and writes with skills_edit_body after a confirmation; the text stays in the dialog and travels on stdin

skills.edit-frontmatter.summary: The description field of the editor: previewed as its own step and written with skills_edit_frontmatter (patch of the description) after the same confirmation

skills.delete.summary: Delete from library on a library skill: preview of the folder, typed confirmation of the skill name, then skills_delete; unlike Uninstall it leaves the synced copies in the clients

skills.transpilers.summary: Converted for: the clients skills are converted for, from skills_list_transpilers, with loading, error and retry states

agents.edit-body.summary: Edit body on an agent card: reads the file with agents_get, previews the change and writes with agents_edit_body after a confirmation; the text stays in the dialog

agents.transpilers.summary: Converted for: the clients agents are converted for, from agents_list_transpilers

styles.edit-body.summary: Edit body on a style card: reads the file with styles_get, previews the change and writes with styles_edit_body after a confirmation

styles.transpilers.summary: Converted for: the native-toggle clients and the always-on clients, from styles_list_transpilers

servers.detect-source.summary: Where a server came from: kind, stored or only detected, path and branch (servers_detect_source, read on request)

servers.git-status.summary: Git state of a checkout: branch, upstream, ahead and behind, uncommitted changes and the upstream commits (servers_git_status, read after the source is git)

servers.check-updates.summary: Check one server for updates from its detail, with the update command it would run (servers_check_updates; System > Updates lists every server through the update command)

servers.apply-update.summary: Update one server after a plan that names its stored update command (servers_apply_update, confirm=true, D-079)

servers.fork-sync.summary: Sync a git checkout with its upstream onto a new branch after a plan (servers_fork_sync, confirm=true; a conflict is shown as a stopped sync)

servers.set-mode.summary: Mode of a server: Toolport+ has no per-server modes, so the confirmed call changes nothing and says so (servers_set_mode, D-008)

servers.add-profile-tag.summary: Add a server to a profile by name; a new name creates the profile, which profile edit cannot do (servers_add_profile_tag)

plugins.ls.summary: Library > Plugins: every installed plugin with version, source, where it is on, update state and the projected and measured cost; refresh (--refresh); the list for a folder (--cwd); partial, empty, error and offline states

plugins.show.summary: Plugin detail: what it brings, cost labelled projected or measured, where it is on or off, its settings knobs with where each value comes from, its hooks, and its MCP servers marked not governed; a plugin without an adapter says Claude Code has no per-hook switch

plugins.config.summary: Apply the settings of a plugin to a folder (hook profile, master switch, GateGuard and its exempt paths, hooks switched off): plan with the written-where text and the process warning, confirm, apply, Undo in a folder; an unchanged form sends nothing

plugins.mcp.summary: Deny a plugin MCP server in a folder and allow it again: plan, confirm, apply; the server is listed as not governed by the gateway

plugins.off.summary: Turn a plugin off in the chosen folder (Library > Plugins, and Off here on a plugin row of Context > This folder): dry-run plan with what goes away and what stays, confirm, apply, the undo command; a plan that would write nothing says so

plugins.on.summary: Turn a plugin back on in the folder where it was turned off: plan, confirm, apply, the undo command; a setting Toolport did not write is left alone and said so

plugins.disable.summary: Disable a plugin for every project (user scope, the exact claude plugin command shown): plan, then a typed confirmation of the plugin id, apply, the undo command; a missing claude or an unknown plugin is shown as the refusal

plugins.enable.summary: Enable a plugin again for every project (user scope): plan, confirm, apply, the undo command

hooks.ls.summary: Context > Hooks: folder and tool pickers, the strip (processes for the tool, per answer besides tool calls, run order, who can switch), the before and after lists with owner, background or waits and switch method, the conflicts callout; counted from matchers, not timed

system.cc-list.summary: System > Updates plugin card: the Claude Code plugins with installed version, update state and enabled, read with cc list; the Library plugin rows read the same world

system.cc-update.summary: Update one plugin or all plugins from System > Updates and from Library > Plugins: dry-run plan, confirm, apply, restart note; Toolport does not roll plugins back

attention.ls.summary: The list in three groups with the source, the age, the link to the screen that fixes it and the row's own action (preview first for a writer)

attention.dismiss.summary: Dismiss a row until tomorrow, for a week or for good: dry-run plan, confirm, apply, the undo hint
